sandbachFocus: Sandbach United did not play this week. They remain top of the First Division South with 31 points from 14 games, though they suffered a recent league loss to extend their record to one defeat in their last six league matches (L-W-W-W-W-D).
divisionWide: Eccleshall delivered a devastating performance on Tuesday night, demolishing Telford Town 11-0 at the Lionheart Security Services Stadium. Nicky Parker was the standout performer with four goals, while Dylan Bath scored twice and seven different players got on the scoresheet in total. This emphatic victory moves Eccleshall into contention in the upper half. By contrast, Telford Town's plight deepens — now on a winless run of five consecutive league matches (L-D-L-L-L-L), they sit firmly in the relegation zone with just 7 points from 13 games and face an increasingly desperate battle for survival.
